The card SC-03006-K944 showed 4 online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction, with prior average transaction amount of $104.17 [EV-5aa7cca0, EV-8a2ecafb]. One prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4315) was linked to this customer/card [EV-47488a27], and the device profile appeared in one confirmed fraud case [EV-4630862a]. Six prior closed cases with the same card-not-present fraud pattern were retrieved [EV-cabee3d3]. The customer reported they did not make the purchases and still possessed the card [EV-92180619]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict, pattern card_not_present_fraud, probability 0.835, exposure $454.42 across four transactions.
